title: "pylint.bat" incorrectly installed on OS X
body:
Originally reported by: **Steven Myint (BitBucket: [myint](http://bitbucket.org/myint), GitHub: @myint?)**

---

Is it intended for `*.bat` files to be installed on OS X? It seems to me that they should only be installed on Windows.

```
$ python --version
Python 3.5.0

$ pip install --user pylint

$ file /Users/myint/Library/Python/3.5/bin/pylint.bat
/Users/myint/Library/Python/3.5/bin/pylint.bat: DOS batch file text

$ /Users/myint/Library/Python/3.5/bin/pylint.bat
/Users/myint/Library/Python/3.5/bin/pylint.bat: line 1: @echo: command not found
/Users/myint/Library/Python/3.5/bin/pylint.bat: line 2: rem: command not found
/Users/myint/Library/Python/3.5/bin/pylint.bat: line 3: rem: command not found
/Users/myint/Library/Python/3.5/bin/pylint.bat: line 4: rem: command not found
/opt/local/Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.5/Resources/Python.app/Contents/MacOS/Python: can't open file '%~dpn0': [Errno 2] No such file or directory
```

`pylint` proper works okay. I'm just not sure why the `*.bat` files are installed too.

```
$ /Users/myint/Library/Python/3.5/bin/pylint --version
No config file found, using default configuration
pylint 1.4.4,
astroid 1.3.8, common 1.0.2
Python 3.5.0 (default, Sep 16 2015, 07:03:35)
[GCC 4.2.1 Compatible Apple LLVM 6.0 (clang-600.0.57)]

$ ls -l /Users/myint/Library/Python/3.5/bin/pylint*
-rwxr-xr-x 1 myint staff 225 Sep 17 07:10 /Users/myint/Library/Python/3.5/bin/pylint
-rwxr-xr-x 1 myint staff 233 Sep 17 07:10 /Users/myint/Library/Python/3.5/bin/pylint-gui
-rwxr-xr-x 1 myint staff 203 Sep 17 07:10 /Users/myint/Library/Python/3.5/bin/pylint-gui.bat
-rwxr-xr-x 1 myint staff 203 Sep 17 07:10 /Users/myint/Library/Python/3.5/bin/pylint.bat
```
